user.title: Ecodan Dashboard
user.description: Adds a panel to the sidebar with a live installation diagram of the Ecodan heat pump. The MELCloud entities are detected automatically; the entity prefix and manual mapping can be set later via Configure.

init.title: Ecodan Dashboard
init.description: Changes apply immediately; reload the panel in your browser or app afterwards.

data.prefix: Entity prefix of the Ecodan device

data_description.prefix: The part between the domain and the sensor name, e.g. technische_ruimte_ecodan for sensor.technische_ruimte_ecodan_tanktemperatuur.
data_description.klep_aan_is_tapwater: Turn this off if the diagram shows heating while the tank is being heated.
data_description.overrides: E.g. {"water_heater": "water_heater.ecodan"}. Leave empty for automatic detection. See the README for all keys.
data_description.thema: Default for everyone. The sun/moon button in the panel overrides it per device.
